```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(purrr)
library(rlang)
library(xml2)
library(officer)
library(jupycost)

gdrive_email <- "andy@openscapes.org"

deck_drive_id <- "1GIo__VRaCx4aG-04lwcD93UFHr1k3N4z"
download_deck <- TRUE
template <- "template/NASA-Openscapes_PMR_Slides.pptx"
output <- "output/NASA-Openscapes_PMR_Slides.pptx"
start <- ""
end <- ""
cluster <- "openscapeshub"

for (f in list.files("R", pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE)) {
  source(f)
}

googledrive::drive_auth(email = gdrive_email)
googlesheets4::gs4_auth(email = gdrive_email)

if (isTRUE(download_deck)) {
  dir.create(dirname(template), showWarnings = FALSE)
  googledrive::drive_download(
    googledrive::as_id(deck_drive_id),
    path = template,
    overwrite = TRUE
  )
}
dir.create(dirname(output), showWarnings = FALSE)

deck <- read_pptx(template)
range <- previous_report_range(deck)
start <- if (nzchar(start)) as.Date(start) else range$start
end <- if (nzchar(end)) as.Date(end) else range$end
```

Report period: **`r format_range(start, end)`** (the previous slide ended `r format_day(range$prev_end, "%b %d %Y")`).

## Monthly AWS usage

```{r aws}
costs <- get_report_costs(start, end, cluster = cluster)
usage_plot <- plot_report_costs(costs, start, end)
chart_path <- file.path(dirname(output), "aws-usage.png")
save_usage_plot(usage_plot, chart_path, chart_location(presented_slide(deck)))

caption <- caption_runs(
  attr(usage_plot, "color_key"),
  "https://openscapes.cloud/usage-reporting#monthly-nasa-reports"
)

credits_text <- get_credits_text()
```

![](`r chart_path`){width=70%}

## Engineering issues

```{r engineering}
eng <- get_engineering_issues(start, end)
eng |>
  transmute(
    repo,
    issue = paste0("[#", number, "](", url, ")"),
    activity,
    title
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Events

```{r events}
events <- get_workshop_events(start, end)
planning <- get_planning_activity(start, end, exclude = events$number)

events |>
  transmute(
    issue = paste0("[#", number, "](", url, ")"),
    event,
    event_start,
    event_end,
    participants
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Workshops with a start date in the report period")

planning |>
  transmute(issue = paste0("[#", number, "](", url, ")"), activity, title) |>
  knitr::kable(
    caption = "Other workshop-planning issues active in the report period"
  )
```

## Mentor calls

```{r mentor-calls}
calls <- get_mentor_calls(start, end)
calls |>
  transmute(
    date = format_day(date),
    type = if_else(is_mentor_call, "Mentor call", "Other meeting"),
    summary = map2_chr(summary, title, \(s, t) {
      if (nrow(s)) paste(s$text[s$level == 1], collapse = "<br>") else t
    })
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(escape = FALSE)
```

## Slide

```{r build}
paragraphs <- slide_paragraphs(eng, events, calls, planning)
build_report_deck(
  deck,
  output,
  start,
  end,
  paragraphs,
  chart_path,
  caption,
  credits_text
)

thumb_dir <- file.path(dirname(output), "thumbnail")
if (nzchar(Sys.which("qlmanage"))) {
  dir.create(thumb_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
  system2(
    "qlmanage",
    c("-t", "-s", "1600", "-o", shQuote(thumb_dir), shQuote(output)),
    stdout = FALSE,
    stderr = FALSE
  )
}
thumb <- file.path(thumb_dir, paste0(basename(output), ".png"))
```

New slide inserted at position 1 of `r output`. Items in red on the slide are placeholders to fill in by hand.

```{r thumbnail}
#| results: asis
if (file.exists(thumb)) {
  cat(sprintf("![](%s)", thumb))
}
```
